---- MODULE W4Od12m8p6t1 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Staff == {"a", "b"}
Shelves == {"sh1", "sh2"}
NONE == "none"
MaxGen == 2

VARIABLES coarse, fine, gen, hold, log, inbox

vars == <<coarse, fine, gen, hold, log, inbox>>

Init ==
    /\ coarse = NONE
    /\ fine = [sh \in Shelves |-> NONE]
    /\ gen = 0
    /\ hold = [s \in Staff |-> 0]
    /\ log = {}
    /\ inbox = {}

Request(s, sh) ==
    /\ inbox' = inbox \cup {[who |-> s, shelf |-> sh]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, gen, hold, log>>

AcquireCoarse(s) ==
    /\ coarse = NONE
    /\ coarse' = s
    /\ hold' = [hold EXCEPT ![s] = gen]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, gen, log, inbox>>

AcquireFine(s, sh) ==
    /\ coarse = s
    /\ fine[sh] = NONE
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![sh] = s]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, gen, hold, log, inbox>>

Commit(m) ==
    /\ m \in inbox
    /\ coarse = m.who
    /\ fine[m.shelf] = m.who
    /\ hold[m.who] = gen
    /\ log' = log \cup {[who |-> m.who, shelf |-> m.shelf, g |-> gen]}
    /\ inbox' = inbox \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, gen, hold>>

Revoke(s) ==
    /\ coarse = s
    /\ gen < MaxGen
    /\ coarse' = NONE
    /\ gen' = gen + 1
    /\ fine' = [sh \in Shelves |-> IF fine[sh] = s THEN NONE ELSE fine[sh]]
    /\ hold' = [hold EXCEPT ![s] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<log, inbox>>

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Staff, sh \in Shelves : Request(s, sh)
    \/ \E s \in Staff : AcquireCoarse(s)
    \/ \E s \in Staff, sh \in Shelves : AcquireFine(s, sh)
    \/ \E m \in inbox : Commit(m)
    \/ \E s \in Staff : Revoke(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ coarse \in Staff \cup {NONE}
    /\ fine \in [Shelves -> Staff \cup {NONE}]
    /\ gen \in 0..MaxGen
    /\ hold \in [Staff -> 0..MaxGen]

NoStaleHolder ==
    \A sh \in Shelves :
        fine[sh] # NONE => (coarse = fine[sh] /\ hold[fine[sh]] = gen)

====
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker guards refrigerated units with a two-level (hierarchical) locking scheme. To touch a shelf, a staff member must first acquire the single coarse lock on the whole fridge, then acquire the fine lock on the specific shelf. Because requests travel over a network that may reorder messages, staff first drop a request into a shared inbox; a request may be delivered and committed in any order. A staff member's authority is stamped with the fridge generation at the moment they took the coarse lock. A supervisor may revoke the coarse lock: this bumps the fridge generation, clears the coarse lock, and releases every fine lock that revoked holder was holding, so their stamped generation becomes stale. The action set is: Request (enqueue an inbox message), AcquireCoarse, AcquireFine, Commit (apply an inbox request only while the actor still holds both locks at the current generation), and Revoke.

SAFETY PROPERTY: any staff member currently holding a fine lock on a shelf must also hold the coarse lock and must hold it at the current fridge generation (never stale).

---- MODULE W4Od14m1p0t1 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Drones == {"d1", "d2", "d3"}
MaxPass == 3

VARIABLES holder, inCS, inbox, waiting, passes

vars == <<holder, inCS, inbox, waiting, passes>>

Init ==
    /\ holder = "d1"
    /\ inCS = [d \in Drones |-> FALSE]
    /\ inbox = {}
    /\ waiting = [d \in Drones |-> FALSE]
    /\ passes = 0

Request(d) ==
    /\ ~waiting[d]
    /\ waiting' = [waiting EXCEPT ![d] = TRUE]
    /\ inbox' = inbox \cup {[from |-> d]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, inCS, passes>>

Enter(d) ==
    /\ holder = d
    /\ waiting[d]
    /\ ~inCS[d]
    /\ inCS' = [inCS EXCEPT ![d] = TRUE]
    /\ waiting' = [waiting EXCEPT ![d] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, inbox, passes>>

Exit(d) ==
    /\ inCS[d]
    /\ inCS' = [inCS EXCEPT ![d] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, inbox, waiting, passes>>

Pass(d, e) ==
    /\ holder = d
    /\ ~inCS[d]
    /\ [from |-> e] \in inbox
    /\ passes < MaxPass
    /\ holder' = e
    /\ inbox' = inbox \ {[from |-> e]}
    /\ passes' = passes + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inCS, waiting>>

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Request(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Enter(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Exit(d)
    \/ \E d, e \in Drones : Pass(d, e)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ holder \in Drones
    /\ inCS \in [Drones -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ waiting \in [Drones -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ passes \in 0..MaxPass

MutualExclusion ==
    \A d \in Drones : inCS[d] => holder = d

====
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm shares a single downlink channel (the critical resource) using a token ring. Exactly one token circulates among the drones; only the drone currently holding the token may open the downlink. A drone that needs the channel first broadcasts a request into a shared inbox; because the radio mesh reorders messages, requests may be delivered and served in any order. The token holder, when it is not itself using the channel, passes the token to any drone that has a pending request. The action set is: Request (broadcast a request, marking the drone waiting), Enter (a waiting token-holder opens the downlink), Exit (close the downlink), and Pass (hand the token to a drone with a pending request). A bounded number of passes are modelled.

SAFETY PROPERTY: at any time, any drone with the downlink open must be the current token holder, so at most one drone ever uses the channel.

---- MODULE W4Od17m1p3t4 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Agents == {"g1", "g2"}
Slots == {"s1", "s2", "s3"}
Bags == {"b1", "b2"}
NONE == "none"
MaxPass == 2

VARIABLES holder, bagOf, slotOf, active, passes

vars == <<holder, bagOf, slotOf, active, passes>>

Init ==
    /\ holder = "g1"
    /\ bagOf = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ slotOf = [b \in Bags |-> NONE]
    /\ active = [s \in Slots |-> TRUE]
    /\ passes = 0

Allocate(a, b, s) ==
    /\ holder = a
    /\ active[s]
    /\ bagOf[s] = NONE
    /\ slotOf[b] = NONE
    /\ bagOf' = [bagOf EXCEPT ![s] = b]
    /\ slotOf' = [slotOf EXCEPT ![b] = s]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, active, passes>>

Release(a, b) ==
    /\ holder = a
    /\ slotOf[b] # NONE
    /\ bagOf' = [bagOf EXCEPT ![slotOf[b]] = NONE]
    /\ slotOf' = [slotOf EXCEPT ![b] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, active, passes>>

Grow(s) ==
    /\ ~active[s]
    /\ active' = [active EXCEPT ![s] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, bagOf, slotOf, passes>>

Shrink(s) ==
    /\ active[s]
    /\ bagOf[s] = NONE
    /\ active' = [active EXCEPT ![s] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, bagOf, slotOf, passes>>

Pass(a, e) ==
    /\ holder = a
    /\ passes < MaxPass
    /\ holder' = e
    /\ passes' = passes + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bagOf, slotOf, active>>

Next ==
    \/ \E a \in Agents, b \in Bags, s \in Slots : Allocate(a, b, s)
    \/ \E a \in Agents, b \in Bags : Release(a, b)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Grow(s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Shrink(s)
    \/ \E a, e \in Agents : Pass(a, e)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ holder \in Agents
    /\ bagOf \in [Slots -> Bags \cup {NONE}]
    /\ slotOf \in [Bags -> Slots \cup {NONE}]
    /\ active \in [Slots -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ passes \in 0..MaxPass

MapsConsistent ==
    /\ \A b \in Bags : slotOf[b] # NONE => bagOf[slotOf[b]] = b
    /\ \A s \in Slots : bagOf[s] # NONE => slotOf[bagOf[s]] = s

====
nl:
An airport baggage router assigns bags to carousel slots. A token circulates among router agents; only the agent holding the token may allocate or release a slot. Two mirrored maps are kept: bagOf tells which bag sits in each slot, and slotOf tells which slot each bag occupies. Carousel capacity changes at runtime: slots can be brought online (Grow) or taken offline (Shrink), but a slot may only be taken offline when it is empty. The action set is: Allocate (the token holder binds a free bag to a free, active slot, updating both maps), Release (the token holder frees a bag and its slot in both maps), Grow (activate a slot), Shrink (deactivate an empty slot), and Pass (hand the token to another agent; a bounded number of passes are modelled).

SAFETY PROPERTY: the two maps stay mutually consistent — if a bag occupies a slot then that slot records the same bag, and vice versa — so no slot is ever double-allocated.

---- MODULE W4Od6m4p1t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers, Sequences, FiniteSets

Jobs == {"u1", "u2", "u3"}
NONE == "none"
CAP == 2

VARIABLES queue, history, acked, processing, submitted

vars == <<queue, history, acked, processing, submitted>>

Init ==
    /\ queue = << >>
    /\ history = {}
    /\ acked = {}
    /\ processing = NONE
    /\ submitted = {}

Submit(u) ==
    /\ u \notin submitted
    /\ Len(queue) < CAP
    /\ queue' = Append(queue, u)
    /\ submitted' = submitted \cup {u}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<history, acked, processing>>

StartApply ==
    /\ processing = NONE
    /\ queue # << >>
    /\ processing' = Head(queue)
    /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<history, acked, submitted>>

FinishApply ==
    /\ processing # NONE
    /\ history' = history \cup {processing}
    /\ processing' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, acked, submitted>>

Ack(u) ==
    /\ u \in history
    /\ u \notin acked
    /\ acked' = acked \cup {u}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, history, processing, submitted>>

AdminForce(u) ==
    /\ u \notin history
    /\ history' = history \cup {u}
    /\ acked' = acked \cup {u}
    /\ submitted' = submitted \cup {u}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, processing>>

Recycle(u) ==
    /\ u \in acked
    /\ u \in submitted
    /\ history' = history \ {u}
    /\ acked' = acked \ {u}
    /\ submitted' = submitted \ {u}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, processing>>

Next ==
    \/ \E u \in Jobs : Submit(u)
    \/ StartApply
    \/ FinishApply
    \/ \E u \in Jobs : Ack(u)
    \/ \E u \in Jobs : AdminForce(u)
    \/ \E u \in Jobs : Recycle(u)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ processing \in Jobs \cup {NONE}
    /\ history \subseteq Jobs
    /\ acked \subseteq Jobs
    /\ submitted \subseteq Jobs
    /\ Len(queue) <= CAP

NoLostUpdate ==
    acked \subseteq history

====
nl:
An elevator bank in a skyscraper feeds floor-service jobs through a bounded work queue with backpressure into a single shared service record. Each job is submitted once; when the queue is full the dispatcher applies backpressure and refuses new submissions. A worker pulls the head job, applies it to the shared record's history, and only then acknowledges it back to the client. A privileged building admin may override the queue entirely, forcing a job straight into the record while acknowledging it in the same step. The action set is: Submit (enqueue a fresh job unless the queue is at capacity), StartApply (pull the head job for processing), FinishApply (write the processed job into the record history), Ack (acknowledge a job that is already in the record), AdminForce (override: write a job into the record and acknowledge it together), and Recycle (once a job is acknowledged, clear it from the record, ack set, and submitted set so its slot can be reused for a future cycle).

SAFETY PROPERTY: every acknowledged job is present in the shared record's history, so no acknowledged update is ever lost.

---- MODULE W4Od6m3p3t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Nodes == {"n1", "n2"}
Clients == {"c1", "c2"}
Slots == {"s1", "s2"}
NONE == "none"
MaxTerm == 2

VARIABLES leader, term, owner, claim, up

vars == <<leader, term, owner, claim, up>>

Init ==
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ term = 0
    /\ owner = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ claim = [c \in Clients |-> NONE]
    /\ up = [n \in Nodes |-> TRUE]

Elect(n) ==
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ up[n]
    /\ term < MaxTerm
    /\ leader' = n
    /\ term' = term + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, claim, up>>

Fail(n) ==
    /\ leader = n
    /\ leader' = NONE
    /\ up' = [up EXCEPT ![n] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, owner, claim>>

Recover(n) ==
    /\ ~up[n]
    /\ up' = [up EXCEPT ![n] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, owner, claim>>

Allocate(c, s) ==
    /\ leader # NONE
    /\ owner[s] = NONE
    /\ claim[c] = NONE
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = c]
    /\ claim' = [claim EXCEPT ![c] = s]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, up>>

AdminForceAllocate(c, s) ==
    /\ owner[s] = NONE
    /\ claim[c] = NONE
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = c]
    /\ claim' = [claim EXCEPT ![c] = s]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, up>>

Release(c) ==
    /\ claim[c] # NONE
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![claim[c]] = NONE]
    /\ claim' = [claim EXCEPT ![c] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, up>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Fail(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Recover(n)
    \/ \E c \in Clients, s \in Slots : Allocate(c, s)
    \/ \E c \in Clients, s \in Slots : AdminForceAllocate(c, s)
    \/ \E c \in Clients : Release(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ leader \in Nodes \cup {NONE}
    /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm
    /\ owner \in [Slots -> Clients \cup {NONE}]
    /\ claim \in [Clients -> Slots \cup {NONE}]
    /\ up \in [Nodes -> BOOLEAN]

NoDoubleAllocation ==
    \A c \in Clients : claim[c] # NONE => owner[claim[c]] = c

====
nl:
An elevator bank in a skyscraper uses leader election with failover to decide which controller node allocates floor slots to waiting cars. At most one node is leader per term; when the leader fails, the leadership clears and a surviving node may be elected, bumping the term. Only the leader allocates a free slot to a car, recording both the slot's owner and the car's claimed slot. A privileged admin override may allocate a slot even while there is no leader, but still only to a free slot for a car that holds no slot. The action set is: Elect (a live node with no current leader becomes leader for the next term), Fail (the leader crashes and steps down), Recover (a failed node comes back up), Allocate (the leader binds a free slot to a free car), AdminForceAllocate (override allocation with no leader required), and Release (a car gives up its slot, freeing both records).

SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever a car claims a slot, that slot's recorded owner is exactly that car, so a slot is never allocated to two different cars.

---- MODULE W4Od18m0p3t4 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Users == {"u1", "u2"}
Slots == {"s1", "s2"}
NONE == "none"
MaxVer == 3

VARIABLES owner, held, version, active, pend

vars == <<owner, held, version, active, pend>>

Bump(v) == IF v < MaxVer THEN v + 1 ELSE v

Init ==
    /\ owner = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ held = [u \in Users |-> NONE]
    /\ version = [s \in Slots |-> 0]
    /\ active = [s \in Slots |-> TRUE]
    /\ pend = [u \in Users |-> [slot |-> NONE, ver |-> 0]]

Prepare(u, s) ==
    /\ pend[u].slot = NONE
    /\ active[s]
    /\ held[u] = NONE
    /\ pend' = [pend EXCEPT ![u] = [slot |-> s, ver |-> version[s]]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, held, version, active>>

Commit(u) ==
    /\ pend[u].slot # NONE
    /\ held[u] = NONE
    /\ owner[pend[u].slot] = NONE
    /\ version[pend[u].slot] = pend[u].ver
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![pend[u].slot] = u]
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![u] = pend[u].slot]
    /\ version' = [version EXCEPT ![pend[u].slot] = Bump(version[pend[u].slot])]
    /\ pend' = [pend EXCEPT ![u] = [slot |-> NONE, ver |-> 0]]
    /\ UNCHANGED active

Retry(u) ==
    /\ pend[u].slot # NONE
    /\ \/ owner[pend[u].slot] # NONE
       \/ version[pend[u].slot] # pend[u].ver
    /\ pend' = [pend EXCEPT ![u] = [slot |-> NONE, ver |-> 0]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, held, version, active>>

Release(u) ==
    /\ held[u] # NONE
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![held[u]] = NONE]
    /\ version' = [version EXCEPT ![held[u]] = Bump(version[held[u]])]
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![u] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<active, pend>>

Grow(s) ==
    /\ ~active[s]
    /\ active' = [active EXCEPT ![s] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, held, version, pend>>

Shrink(s) ==
    /\ active[s]
    /\ owner[s] = NONE
    /\ active' = [active EXCEPT ![s] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, held, version, pend>>

Next ==
    \/ \E u \in Users, s \in Slots : Prepare(u, s)
    \/ \E u \in Users : Commit(u)
    \/ \E u \in Users : Retry(u)
    \/ \E u \in Users : Release(u)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Grow(s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Shrink(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ owner \in [Slots -> Users \cup {NONE}]
    /\ held \in [Users -> Slots \cup {NONE}]
    /\ version \in [Slots -> 0..MaxVer]
    /\ active \in [Slots -> BOOLEAN]

NoDoubleBinding ==
    \A s \in Slots : owner[s] # NONE => held[owner[s]] = s

====
nl:
A smart-home door-lock network hands out access slots to users using optimistic locking with retry. To claim a slot a user first prepares, snapshotting the slot's current version. The claim commits only if, at commit time, the slot is still free and its version still equals the snapshot; a successful commit binds the slot to the user and bumps the slot version. If the snapshot is stale (the slot became occupied or its version moved) the user abandons and retries. Slot capacity changes at runtime: slots can be activated or, when empty, deactivated. The action set is: Prepare (snapshot a free active slot), Commit (bind slot to user if the snapshot is still valid and the user holds no slot), Retry (drop a stale pending claim), Release (a user gives up its slot, bumping the version), Grow (activate a slot), and Shrink (deactivate an empty slot).

SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever a slot records an owner, that owner is holding exactly that slot, so no slot is ever bound to two users at once.

---- MODULE W4Od16m3p1t2 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Nodes == {"n1", "n2"}
Scripts == {"r1", "r2", "r3"}
NONE == "none"
MaxTerm == 2

VARIABLES leader, term, up, ledger, confirmed

vars == <<leader, term, up, ledger, confirmed>>

Init ==
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ term = 0
    /\ up = [n \in Nodes |-> TRUE]
    /\ ledger = {}
    /\ confirmed = {}

Elect(n) ==
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ up[n]
    /\ leader' = n
    /\ term' = IF term < MaxTerm THEN term + 1 ELSE term
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, ledger, confirmed>>

Fail(n) ==
    /\ leader = n
    /\ leader' = NONE
    /\ up' = [up EXCEPT ![n] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, ledger, confirmed>>

Recover(n) ==
    /\ ~up[n]
    /\ up' = [up EXCEPT ![n] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, ledger, confirmed>>

Dispense(rx) ==
    /\ leader # NONE
    /\ rx \notin ledger
    /\ ledger' = ledger \cup {rx}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, up, confirmed>>

Confirm(rx) ==
    /\ rx \in ledger
    /\ rx \notin confirmed
    /\ confirmed' = confirmed \cup {rx}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, up, ledger>>

Recycle(rx) ==
    /\ rx \in confirmed
    /\ ledger' = ledger \ {rx}
    /\ confirmed' = confirmed \ {rx}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, up>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Fail(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Recover(n)
    \/ \E rx \in Scripts : Dispense(rx)
    \/ \E rx \in Scripts : Confirm(rx)
    \/ \E rx \in Scripts : Recycle(rx)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ leader \in Nodes \cup {NONE}
    /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm
    /\ up \in [Nodes -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ ledger \subseteq Scripts
    /\ confirmed \subseteq Scripts

NoLostConfirm ==
    confirmed \subseteq ledger

====
nl:
A pharmacy prescription dispenser runs two independent dispensing instances that share one prescription pool and one shared dispense ledger. Controller nodes run leader election with failover: at most one node leads per term, and if the leader fails a survivor may take over. Only the current leader may dispense a prescription, appending it to the shared ledger. An instance confirms a dispense back to the patient only after the prescription is recorded in the shared ledger. To keep the pool cycling, a confirmed prescription may be recycled, which removes it from both the ledger and the confirmed set together. The action set is: Elect, Fail, Recover, Dispense (the leader appends a fresh prescription to the shared ledger), Confirm (acknowledge a prescription already in the ledger), and Recycle (drop a confirmed prescription from the ledger and confirmed set together).

SAFETY PROPERTY: every confirmed prescription is present in the shared dispense ledger, so no confirmed dispense is ever lost.

---- MODULE W4Od17m1p0t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Agents == {"a1", "a2", "a3"}
MaxPass == 3
MaxAdmin == 2

Nxt(a) == CASE a = "a1" -> "a2"
            [] a = "a2" -> "a3"
            [] a = "a3" -> "a1"

VARIABLES token, busy, req, passes, adminUses

vars == <<token, busy, req, passes, adminUses>>

Init ==
    /\ token = "a1"
    /\ busy = [a \in Agents |-> FALSE]
    /\ req = [a \in Agents |-> FALSE]
    /\ passes = 0
    /\ adminUses = 0

Request(a) ==
    /\ ~req[a]
    /\ req' = [req EXCEPT ![a] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, busy, passes, adminUses>>

Acquire(a) ==
    /\ token = a
    /\ req[a]
    /\ ~busy[a]
    /\ busy' = [busy EXCEPT ![a] = TRUE]
    /\ req' = [req EXCEPT ![a] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, passes, adminUses>>

Leave(a) ==
    /\ busy[a]
    /\ busy' = [busy EXCEPT ![a] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, req, passes, adminUses>>

Pass(a) ==
    /\ token = a
    /\ ~busy[a]
    /\ passes < MaxPass
    /\ token' = Nxt(a)
    /\ passes' = passes + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<busy, req, adminUses>>

AdminReassign(a) ==
    /\ adminUses < MaxAdmin
    /\ \A x \in Agents : ~busy[x]
    /\ token' = a
    /\ adminUses' = adminUses + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<busy, req, passes>>

Next ==
    \/ \E a \in Agents : Request(a)
    \/ \E a \in Agents : Acquire(a)
    \/ \E a \in Agents : Leave(a)
    \/ \E a \in Agents : Pass(a)
    \/ \E a \in Agents : AdminReassign(a)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ token \in Agents
    /\ busy \in [Agents -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ req \in [Agents -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ passes \in 0..MaxPass
    /\ adminUses \in 0..MaxAdmin

MutualExclusion ==
    \A a \in Agents : busy[a] => token = a

====
nl:
An airport baggage router serializes access to a single sorting bay (the critical resource) with a token ring. A token sits with exactly one router agent; agents are arranged in a ring and the holder, when idle, passes the token to its ring-neighbor. An agent that needs the bay first raises a request; only a requesting agent that holds the token may occupy the bay, and it must leave before the token moves on. A privileged operations admin may override the ring and reassign the token to any agent, but only while the bay is completely idle. A bounded number of ring passes and admin reassignments are modelled. The action set is: Request (an agent flags that it wants the bay), Acquire (a requesting token-holder occupies the bay), Leave (vacate the bay), Pass (the idle holder hands the token to its ring-neighbor), and AdminReassign (override: move the token to any agent while the bay is idle).

SAFETY PROPERTY: any agent occupying the sorting bay must be the current token holder, so the bay is never occupied by two agents at once.

---- MODULE W4Od15m8p4t4 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Traders == {"t1", "t2"}
Levels == {"L1", "L2"}
NONE == "none"
MaxCap == 3

    /\ sessionVer' = [sessionVer EXCEPT ![c] = specVer]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<specVer, granted, slow>>

Grant(c) ==
    /\ ~slow[c]
    /\ sessionVer[c] = specVer
    /\ ~granted[c]
    /\ granted' = [granted EXCEPT ![c] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<specVer, sessionVer, slow>>

Release(c) ==
    /\ granted[c]
    /\ granted' = [granted EXCEPT ![c] = FALSE]
    /\ sessionVer' = [sessionVer EXCEPT ![c] = NOSESS]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<specVer, slow>>

Retry(c) ==
    /\ sessionVer[c] # NOSESS
    /\ sessionVer[c] # specVer
    /\ ~granted[c]
    /\ sessionVer' = [sessionVer EXCEPT ![c] = NOSESS]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<specVer, granted, slow>>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ specVer < MaxVer
    /\ specVer' = specVer + 1
    /\ granted' = [c \in Clients |-> FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<sessionVer, slow>>

SlowDown(c) ==
    /\ ~slow[c]
    /\ slow' = [slow EXCEPT ![c] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<specVer, sessionVer, granted>>

SpeedUp(c) ==
    /\ slow[c]
    /\ slow' = [slow EXCEPT ![c] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<specVer, sessionVer, granted>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Clients : OpenSession(c)
    \/ \E c \in Clients : Grant(c)
    \/ \E c \in Clients : Release(c)
    \/ \E c \in Clients : Retry(c)
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ \E c \in Clients : SlowDown(c)
    \/ \E c \in Clients : SpeedUp(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ specVer \in 0..MaxVer
    /\ sessionVer \in [Clients -> NOSESS..MaxVer]
    /\ granted \in [Clients -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ slow \in [Clients -> BOOLEAN]

NoStaleGrant ==
    \A c \in Clients : granted[c] => sessionVer[c] = specVer

nl:
A print shop job spooler guards the spool with optimistic locking with retry. A client opens a session by snapshotting the spool's current configuration version. Only a client whose session snapshot still matches the current version (authorized and fresh) may be granted the print lock. A client can be slow but never fails: while slow it cannot open a session or take a grant, but it always eventually speeds up. The shop may reconfigure the spool, which bumps the configuration version and revokes any outstanding print grant; sessions opened against the old version become stale and must be retried (dropped and reopened). The action set is: OpenSession (a responsive client snapshots the current version), Grant (a responsive client with a fresh matching session takes the print lock), Release (a client drops its grant and session), Retry (drop a stale session whose snapshot no longer matches), Reconfigure (bump the version and revoke grants), SlowDown (a client becomes slow), and SpeedUp (a slow client becomes responsive).

SAFETY PROPERTY: any client holding the print grant has a session snapshot equal to the current configuration version, so no stale or unauthorized client ever holds the lock.
